title: OpenAI introduces dots, always-on ChatGPT agents with their own cloud computer and browser
detail: As documented on 2026-11-14, dots are rolling out gradually to eligible Pro and Business Premium accounts and are available in eligible Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces; they became the first surface for ChatGPT Wallet on 2026-11-13.

title: American Express publishes its Intent Intelligence framework
detail: A Create Intent API, an Intent ID and a Proof of Intent Token (a JSON Web Token) that can scope the agent's payment credential to the authenticated intent; part of the ACE Developer Kit, whose program page lists the Intent Intelligence specification as available since 2026-04-14.

title: ChatGPT Wallet launches in dots for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers
detail: Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa: the user approves each purchase with a security check, and the card network supplies a payment token that the dot enters in the merchant's existing checkout. OpenAI does not present Wallet as ACP; its post quotes American Express calling Wallet its first ACE integration.
